aapl.note: Rainbow apple designed by Rob Janoff, in use 1977 to 1998/1999 (Wikipedia, Apple Inc.: original official logo used from 1977 to 1999).

Monochrome apple. Wikipedia (Apple Inc.) captions the monochrome logo "used since 1999"; the move away from the rainbow began in 1998, but 1999 is the earliest date a source supports, so January 1999.

amzn.note: Amazon.com logo with the river-A symbol, "1995-1997" per 1000logos.net/amazon-logo (image Amazon-Logo-1995.png). Intermediate 1997-1999 versions (zebra A, serif wordmark, orange-O wordmark) are dated only vaguely by that site and are not listed; the older logo is kept until January 2000.
amazon.com wordmark with the smile arrow, launched January 25, 2000 and retired in 2012 (Commons).
Amazon wordmark with smile, "launched in 2012, retired on November 1, 2024" (Commons). Only the year is known for the start.
Amazon logo in Amazon Sans, first revealed April 15, 2024 and taking over from the 2012 logo on November 1, 2024 (Commons); November is used because that is when the old logo was retired.

ba.note: Boeing italic wordmark ("Stratotype"). Commons says first introduced in 1947, 1000logos.net/boeing-logo gives 1960-1997 for this style; the later year is used. Replaced in 1997.
Boeing wordmark with the symbol after the McDonnell Douglas merger, "logo used since 1997" (Wikipedia, Boeing; Commons date 1997-08-01).

bmw.note: BMW roundel in the 1963 drawing (flat, black ring), "1963-1997" per Commons and 1000logos.net/bmw-logo. Only the year is known.
BMW roundel with the 3D/chrome-effect rendering of 1997, "BMW-Logo (1997-2020)" per Commons; 1000logos.net/bmw-logo: 1997 to today. Only the year is known.

Flat transparent BMW roundel, "BMW-Logo (2020-)" (Commons file BMW logo (gray).svg dated 6 March 2020; the file used here is the raster BMW 2020.webp, converted to PNG). Month is the March 2020 unveiling.

c.note: CITIGROUP in white on blue with the red Travelers umbrella, "1998-1999" per 1000logos.net/citigroup-logo (image Citicorp-Logo-1998.png; the site names the files Citicorp). Citigroup was formed in October 1998.
Blue "citigroup" wordmark with the red umbrella, "1999-2007" per 1000logos.net/citigroup-logo (image Citicorp-Logo-1999.png). Only the year is known.
Grey "citi" with red arc, 2007 to 2011 per 1000logos.net/citigroup-logo and "2007 to 2012" per Commons File:Citigroup.svg. Only the year is known; the PNG is from 1000logos.net.

Blue "citi" with red arc, "the original blue word mark was re-employed" in 2012 (Commons File:Citigroup.svg description; this file uploaded 3 July 2012). 1000logos.net says 2011; the later year is used to avoid showing the logo too early.
Brighter blue Citi logo, "introduced (without official announcement) in March 2023" (Commons).

credit-suisse.note: Credit Suisse / SKA bar logo with the CS emblem, "1976-1997" per 1000logos.net/credit-suisse-logo (image Credit-Suisse-Logo-1976.png). The CS Holding rename of 1989 did not change it. Only the year is known.
Stacked blue/red CREDIT SUISSE logo, "1997-2006" per 1000logos.net/credit-suisse-logo (Commons "Altes Logo"). Only the year is known.
Credit Suisse wordmark with sails, "2006-2014/2022" per 1000logos.net/credit-suisse-logo. Only the year is known.
Credit Suisse Group logo "from 2022 until the dissolution in 2023" (Commons).

csco.note: Cisco Systems logo with the Golden Gate bridge motif, "used from 1990 to 1996" (Commons). Only the year is known.
Cisco Systems logo with red lettering and blue bridge, "used from 1996 to 2006" (Commons). Only the year is known.
CISCO wordmark in red with blue bridge bars, 2006 to 2013 per 1000logos.net/cisco-logo (image Cisco-Logo-2006.png). Only the year is known.
Lowercase blue "cisco" with bars. 1000logos.net/cisco-logo gives 2013 for the start of the current logo, the Commons file is dated 2016; the later year is used.

dis.note: Walt Disney Productions wordmark in script with "Productions", "1972-1983" per 1000logos.net/walt-disney-logo (image Walt-Disney-Logo-1972.png); the company was called Walt Disney Productions until 1986. Only the year is known.

Walt Disney signature wordmark (Commons, circa 1956), which served as the corporate logo of The Walt Disney Company after the 1986 rename. No source states when it was adopted for the company; the month is the rename month and is an assumption.
"The Walt Disney Company" wordmark, "logo used since 2012" (Wikipedia, The Walt Disney Company; Commons date 2012). Only the year is known.

ebay.note: Serif "EBAY" wordmark, 1997 to 1999 per 1000logos.net/ebay-logo (image Ebay-Logo-1997.jpg, converted to PNG). Only the year is known.
eBay logo with overlapping letters, "1999-2012" (Commons; Wikipedia: former eBay logo 1999-2012).

enron.note: Enron Corp wordmark designed by Lippincott & Margulies, "used from 1986 to 1997" (Commons, dated 1986-04-10).
Tilted "E" by Paul Rand, introduced 1997 (the year given in the task and in the Commons file name; the Commons file itself has no date). Only the year is known.

ge.note: GE monogram in a circle, the 1969 redesign with bolder lines, "1969-1987" per 1000logos.net/ge-logo (image GE-Logo-1969.jpg, converted to PNG, drawn in black). Only the year is known.
GE monogram, minor refinement of 1987 (letters drawn slightly smaller), "1987-1998" per 1000logos.net/ge-logo. Only the year is known.
GE monogram with shortened lines, "1998-today" per 1000logos.net/ge-logo. Only the year is known.

GE monogram in the blue of the 2004 identity refresh (Commons file date circa 2004; Wikipedia, General Electric, mentions small logo modifications with the new corporate palette). Only the year is known.
GE Aerospace logo (monogram in a dark roundel with wordmark), used from the April 2024 spin-off of GE Vernova when the company was renamed GE Aerospace; exact day of first use not established.

glencore.note: Glencore wordmark, Commons date 2011-05-20 (the month of the IPO).

ibj.note: Industrial Bank of Japan logo with the bank name in a gold box. The file has no date; no source dates this logo, so it is assigned to the start of the game for this company (data starts 1985-05).

ibm.note: Eight-bar IBM wordmark by Paul Rand, in use since 1972 (Wikipedia, IBM: current 8-bar logo designed in 1972, replacing the 13-bar logo; Commons file date 1972). Only the year is known, so January.

intc.note: Intel "dropped-e" logo (the 1991 Landor variant is the one drawn in the file); used from April 1969 until January 2, 2006 per Wikipedia (Intel) and Commons ("Apr 1969 - Dec 2005"). Listed from 1975-01 because the game starts later; real first use April 1969.
Intel swoosh logo by FutureBrand, introduced January 3, 2006 (Wikipedia, Intel).
Intel logo in Intel One typeface, introduced September 2, 2020 (Wikipedia, Intel; Commons "2020-").

ko.note: Coca-Cola script wordmark, the logo of the company; Wikipedia (Coca-Cola) captions this version "Logo used since 1946", Commons file date August 1946. The script itself is far older; only the year is known, so January.

lehman.note: Lehman Brothers green serif wordmark. No source dates it; assigned to the first month of the game data (the May 1994 spin-off from American Express).

mcd.note: Golden Arches with McDonald's wordmark across them, "corporate logo used from November 18, 1968, until 2003" (Wikipedia, McDonald's). The red-box variant (1975 on, Commons) is a variant of the same logo and not listed separately.
Plain golden arches, "used since 2006" (Wikipedia, McDonald's; 1000logos: 2006 to today). Month not established; September is the Commons upload month (2006-09-28), so approximate.

mercedes.note: Three-pointed star in a ring with Mercedes-Benz wordmark in sans serif, "first published in 1969" (Commons); used until the 1989 redesign. This is the brand logo of Daimler-Benz cars; the group wordmark DAIMLER-BENZ (Commons File:Daimler-Benz_Logo_alt.svg) has no date in the sources and is not used.
Star in ring with serif Mercedes-Benz wordmark, "first published in 1989" (Commons; second file Mercedes benz logo1989.png dated 1989-07-30). Only the year is known.
DaimlerChrysler AG wordmark (Commons, date 1998), used from the merger in November 1998 until the 2007 rename.
Daimler AG wordmark in blue, used after the October 2007 name change from DaimlerChrysler (Commons; file uploaded 2009). The exact date of first use is not given.
Mercedes-Benz Group wordmark, dated 2022-01-31 in Commons; company renamed in February 2022.

mo.note: Philip Morris crest with rampant lions, PM shield and "Veni Vidi Vici" ribbon, "1954-1987" per 1000logos.net/philip-morris-logo (image Philip-Morris-Logo-1954.png). Listed from 1954 as the logo in use at the start of the game.
Philip Morris crest with black outline and "Philip Morris International" ribbon, "1987-2008" per 1000logos.net/philip-morris-logo (image Philip-Morris-Logo-1987.png). Only the year is known.
Altria Group logo with the colour-square mosaic. No source gives the first-use date of this drawing; it is set to January 2003, the rename month in universe.ts. The Commons file gives no date.

msft.note: Microsoft wordmark with the "blibbet" O, used until 1987 per Commons; start year 1982 from the file name. Only the year is known.
Italic "Pac-Man" Microsoft logo by Scott Baker, introduced 1987 (Commons date 1987-02-26), in use until 2012.
Four-square logo with grey wordmark, introduced August 23, 2012 (Commons).

nestle.note: Nestlé wordmark in black capitals with the bird nest (1966, "1966-1988" per 1000logos.net/nestle-logo; image Nestle-Logo-1966.jpg). The file is a coarse raster. Only the year is known.
Nestlé nest with bold "Nestlé" wordmark, "1988-1995" per 1000logos.net/nestle-logo (image Nestle-Logo-1984.jpg, so the file name and header disagree; the header year is used). Only the year is known.
Nestlé nest with updated lettering, "1995-2015" per 1000logos.net/nestle-logo (image Nestle-Logo-1995.jpg). Only the year is known.
Nestlé refreshed nest and wordmark, "2015-today" per 1000logos.net/nestle-logo (image Nestle-Logo-2015.png). Only the year is known.

nokia.note: Nokia wordmark in blue, "used from 1978 to 2023" (Commons; 1000logos.net/nokia-logo agrees). Only the year is known.
New Nokia logo by Lippincott, registered 16 January 2023 and made official 25 February 2023 (Commons).

novartis.note: Novartis wordmark with the double-stem symbol, "1996-2017" per 1000logos.net/novartis-logo (image Novartis-Logo-1996.png). Listed from January 1996 as the logo adopted with the name, before the December 1996 merger.
Redrawn Novartis logo, Commons date 2023-12-04. 1000logos.net says 2017 for the "current" logo; the two drawings are almost identical. The later date is used.

nvda.note: Nvidia eye logo with italic "nVIDIA" wordmark, 1993 to 2006 (1000logos.net/nvidia-logo, image Nvidia-Logo-1993.png; Commons describes the old wordmark as "used 1993-2006").
Nvidia eye logo with bold wordmark, "logo since 2006" (Wikipedia, Nvidia infobox caption). Only the year is known.

pcln.note: priceline.com logo. The Commons file (uploaded 2011) gives no first-use date; Priceline launched in April 1998 and the logo is assumed unchanged until the 2014 rename, which is not documented in the sources used.
The Priceline Group logo (grey), Commons date 2016-01-02. The company took the name Priceline Group in 2014, but the first-use date of this logo is not documented; the Commons date is used.
Booking Holdings logo, Commons date 2018-02-21 (rename month).

pets-com.note: Pets.com logo, green with paw print and slogan "because pets can't drive". The company was founded in August 1998; the file has no date. The sock puppet is a mascot and not used.

sandoz.note: Sandoz wordmark with the small flask symbol, the pre-1996 style. No source dates this drawing; it is assigned to the start of the game for this company. Commons file is only 179x37 pixels.

sbv.note: Swiss Bank Corporation logo with the three keys (keys logo adopted 1937 per Wikipedia, UBS; this lettering drawing is dated 1973 in the file name). Only the year is known.

siemens.note: Siemens wordmark in black, "logo of Siemens from 1973" (Commons). 1000logos.net/siemens-logo lists a similar plain wordmark as 1936-1991; the dates disagree and 1973 is the earlier-supported year in the Commons record.
Siemens wordmark in petrol, 1991 to today per 1000logos.net/siemens-logo. Only the year is known.

slb.note: Original Schlumberger wordmark in capitals with alternating bold and thin strokes, "1926-1998" per 1000logos.net/schlumberger-logo (image Schlumberger-Logo-1926.png, a low-quality grey raster). Listed from 1975-01 because the game starts later than the real first use (1926).
Blue condensed "Schlumberger" wordmark, "1998-2022" per 1000logos.net/schlumberger-logo; Wikipedia: logo used until October 2022. Only the year is known.
SLB logo introduced October 2022 (Commons metadata 2022-10-24; Wikipedia: logo used since October 2022).

sony.note: Sony wordmark in a modified Clarendon typeface, 1973 per Commons metadata and 1000logos.net/sony-logo (1973 to today). Only the year is known.

tsla.note: Tesla "T" shield with TESLA wordmark; 1000logos.net/tesla-logo gives 2004 to today for the logo (company founded July 2003). Commons file uploaded January 2006. The 2017 name change to Tesla, Inc. left the logo unchanged. Only the year is known.

ubs.note: Union Bank of Switzerland logo with the UBS/SBG roundel (English and German initials). The Wikipedia file has no date; the logo is assigned to 1975, the start of the game; the right side of the picture is cut off in the source file.
UBS three keys with red UBS letters, adopted at the June 1998 merger; the three-keys symbol was carried over from Swiss Bank Corporation (Wikipedia, UBS).

wmt.note: Wal-Mart in the frontier-style typeface; Wikipedia (Walmart) infobox caption "Logo used from 1975 to 1981" (the earlier 1962-1975 logo is a letter-spaced sans serif). Commons file is named 1977.
WAL-MART in bold sans serif, "used from 1981-1992" per Commons and Wikipedia infobox caption "Logo used from 1981 to 1992". Month unknown, so January.
WAL*MART with the star, Commons date 1992-06-24; Wikipedia caption "Logo used from 1992 to 2008".
Walmart wordmark with the Spark, in use from June 30, 2008 (Commons; Wikipedia: debuted on the website July 1, 2008). Stores changed over from fall 2008, so July is the earliest month of use.
Walmart logo in use since January 13, 2025 (Commons; Wikipedia).

worldcom.note: WORLDCOM logo with the orange star (the LDDS WorldCom identity of 1995, designed by Glenn Monigle & Associates, per logos.fandom.com via search result). Not dated in the file.
MCI WORLDCOM logo after the MCI acquisition in September 1998.
APPROXIMATION: the logo of the May 2000 relaunch as WorldCom was not found; this is a copy of the 1995 WORLDCOM wordmark (the nearest logo without the MCI name), not the logo actually used from 2000.

xom.note: Exxon double-X logo by Raymond Loewy, in use since 1972 (Commons metadata date 1972; 1000logos.net/exxon-logo: Exxon logo has not changed much since 1972). Only the year is known, so January.
ExxonMobil wordmark with the Exxon double X, used after the November 30, 1999 merger. Commons gives no date of first use; the month is the merger/rename month from universe.ts.

xstrata.note: Xstrata logo with the stylised X. The Commons file gives no date; March 2002 is the London listing (Wikipedia, Xstrata). Listed from there because the game data starts in May 2002.
